title: Augustine's Expositions on the Psalms
author: Augustine of Hippo
license: Public domain (Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, First Series, Vol. 8, 1888)
description: Church-father exposition of the Psalms, represented by the anonymous English translation edited by Philip Schaff in Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, First Series, volume 8. The bundled edition covers all 150 Psalms; it is intentionally a Psalms-only source, not a whole-Bible commentary.
attribution: Augustine of Hippo, Expositions on the Psalms — anonymous English translation in Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, First Series, Vol. 8 (1888), public-domain edition
